models_evaluated: convolutional neural network (50 replicate single instance learning models)

links.outcome: Consistency of embryo rank ordering across replicate models and critical error rates
links.effect: Poor rank-order consistency (Kendall's W approximately 0.35) and critical error rates of approximately 15% across replicate models with identical architectures and similar AUC (~60%).
links.quote: The AI models demonstrated poor consistency in embryo rank ordering (Kendall's W approximately 0.35) and exhibited high critical error rates (approximately 15%), often ranking lower-quality embryos above viable ones.

links.outcome: Model stability when tested on data from a different fertility center
links.effect: Model instability increased on external center data (error variance delta: 46.07%^2), showing sensitivity to distribution shift.
links.quote: When tested on data from a different fertility center, model instability increased (error variance delta: 46.07%<sup>2</sup>), highlighting sensitivity to distribution shifts.

unlisted_practices: Assessing replicate-model (random initialization) stability and rank-order consistency of AI models before deployment

screen.reason: Empirically investigates model stability, intermodel variability, and distribution shifts (safety/reliability issues) of AI for embryo ranking across replicate models and datasets.
